meta.name: react-expert
meta.description: Use when building React 18+ applications in .jsx or .tsx files, Next.js App Router projects, or create-react-app setups. Creates components, implements custom hooks, debugs rendering issues, migrates class components to functional, and implements state management. Invoke for Server Components, Suspense boundaries, useActionState forms, performance optimization, or React 19 features.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建 React 组件与自定义 Hook，处理渲染问题和旧代码迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 React 做前端开发，需要写组件、调渲染或改旧代码。
copy.tagline_en: Build React components and hooks, debug rendering issues, and migrate legacy code.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're developing React apps and need help with components, rendering, and code migration.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会以资深 React 专家的方式处理前端代码：写组件、自定义 Hook、状态管理（Redux、Zustand 等），调试渲染问题，把类组件改函数组件，并产出带类型定义的代码和测试。
howto.when: 当你在 React 18+ 的 .jsx/.tsx 文件中开发、使用 Next.js App Router、或 create-react-app 项目时触发；也适用于 Server Components、Suspense 边界、useActionState 表单等 React 19 相关任务。

say.text: 帮我用 useActionState 写一个待办表单
say.note: 会生成带类型定义的 React 19 表单组件。

say.text: 把这个类组件改写成函数组件
say.note: 按迁移指南完成改写并保持行为一致。

say.text: 我的列表组件用索引做 key，帮我修复
say.note: 会修复 key 并解释原因。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude handles React code like a specialist: creates components, custom hooks, state management (Redux, Zustand), debugs rendering, migrates classes to functions, outputs TypeScript code and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when building React 18+ apps in .jsx/.tsx, Next.js App Router, or create-react-app; also for Server Components, Suspense, useActionState forms, and other React 19 tasks.

say_en.text: Write a todo form using useActionState for me.
say_en.note: Generates a typed React 19 form component.

say_en.text: Rewrite this class component as a functional one.
say_en.note: Migrates it while keeping the same behavior.

say_en.text: My list uses index as key—help me fix it.
say_en.note: Fixes the key and explains why.
